core_obligations: Show that the relative naive cotangent complexes of the henselizations are acyclic using the colimit presentation by etale algebras (proof lines 8536-8539).
Apply the Jacobi-Zariski sequence to the chain of ring maps to remove the henselization of the source (proof lines 8540-8544).
Use the six-term exact sequence for a colimit of local complete intersections to compare the base changed naive cotangent complex with the one over the henselization (proof lines 8545-8549).
Conclude the henselization case and note that the strict henselization case is identical (proof lines 8550-8555).
proof_roadmap: Acyclicity of the relative complexes (proof lines 8536-8539).
Removing the source henselization via Jacobi-Zariski (proof lines 8540-8544).
Comparing with the target via the six-term sequence (proof lines 8545-8555).
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the naive cotangent complex of a local homomorphism with the naive cotangent complex after passing to henselization or strict henselization: base changing the former along the henselization is shown to induce isomorphisms on cohomology with the latter. The proof uses that henselizations are filtered colimits of etale algebras, so the relative naive cotangent complexes appearing are acyclic, applies the Jacobi-Zariski sequence to the chain of ring maps to remove the intermediate step, and then invokes a six-term exact Jacobi-Zariski sequence associated to a colimit of local complete intersections to compare the base change of the original naive cotangent complex with the one over the henselization. The strict henselization case is asserted to follow in the same manner.
